title: System1 Named One of the Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News & World Report
body_markdown:
Great teams build great companies. That’s why System1 is proud to be named one of the Best Companies to Work For in the West by


**[U.S. News & World Report.](https://money.usnews.com/careers/companies/best-116184601)**


This recognition reflects our commitment to[creating a workplace](https://system1.com/careers#values) that supports, empowers and inspires.


#### **Highlights:**


- **Quality of Pay and Benefits:** System1 earned high marks for very competitive compensation and standout perks that include technology and fitness stipends, plus support for professional development.


- **Work-Life Balance and Flexibility:** We prioritize our team’s wellbeing through generous holidays and PTO with an open sick policy, so employees can care for themselves and their families.


####


#### **Why This Matters:**


U.S. News & World Report is known for its rigorous methodology, combining public data with employee feedback to spotlight organizations that truly excel in **[workplace culture.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x1dyjIt2NBY)**


This honor is more than a title – it reflects our people-first approach and reinforces System1’s standing as a top-tier employer.


**[Read more from U.S. News & World Report.](https://money.usnews.com/careers/companies/best-116184601)**
